intent: Reproduce and narrowly correct the two repository-map cancellation identity fixtures while preserving cancellation provenance, source selection and no replay.

hosted_failure.head: ac5030cbf0d82fcc9cc32bc845867befe03dda60
hosted_failure.observation: Both failed assertSame for CancellationException. The hosted Gradle test JVM uses -ea; coroutines 1.11.0 defaults debug mode to JVM assertion status and enables stack-trace recovery.

diagnosis: The unchanged production tool rethrows cancellation before fallback handling. Coroutine stack-trace recovery can copy that exception while preserving the original cancellation as its cause. Requiring the top-level throwable to be the original object was a fixture assumption, not loss of cancellation provenance.
correction: Require CancellationException, the unchanged message and the exact original cancellation in a bounded cause chain. Retain the indexing no-fallback assertion and add exact query counts/actions/source selection plus zero fallback calls for both Gateway and phone cases.

validation.qualification: Exactly the two hosted assertSame failures reproduced; the remaining20 tests passed.
All22 tests pass in each mode against unchanged production source. Modes are repeated executions, not66 distinct tests.

validation.mutation: In an isolated compiler-input copy only, replace the rethrown cancellation with a fresh same-type/same-message exception that omits its original cause.
validation.qualification: Both corrected cancellation tests fail specifically at the original-cause assertion in every mode; the other20 tests pass.

validation.additional_checks: CI policy, generated source inventories, dependency catalog, secret scan,2024 literal Android regex patterns (99 dynamic skipped),36 XML resources and whitespace. No full Android result is inferred.

focused_evidence.compiled_inputs: Every full production/test input is copied to a per-phase directory; manifests retain hashes for those inputs, actual source excerpts and their full origin files.
focused_evidence.runtime: JDK21, Kotlin2.4.20, kotlinx-coroutines1.11.0; compiler and test JVMs bounded to512MB and2 processors.
focused_evidence.scope: Actual RepositoryGraphTool, dispatch accounting, metadata observation, privacy/network classification and exception evidence with both complete JUnit test classes. DTOs, unrelated transport/cache/capability ports and optional diagnostic persistence are explicit host boundaries.

limits: Focused component compilation does not qualify the full Android/Robolectric application.
No remote mutations; root owns current-head integration and CI.
